title: RecordsetFltrCritMonitor - Data API
description: Monitors whether the value of an asset attribute is within the threshold of a recordset filter criteria (RFC). You can monitor one or more RFCs for an Asset. This object is available in API version 57.0 and later.

AssetId.description: The ID of the asset to link the RFC to. This field is a relationship field.

Description.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Description.description: The description of the RFC associated with the recordset filter criteria monitor.

IsWithinThreshold.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
IsWithinThreshold.description: Indicates whether the value of the asset attribute is within the threshold of the RFC. The default value is false.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: The name of the recordset filter criteria monitor.

LastReferencedDate.description: The date the value was last referenced.

LastViewedDate.description: The date the value was last viewed.

RecordsetFilterCriteriaId.description: The ID of the recordset filter criteria. This field is a relationship field.

associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. If the API version isn’t specified, they’re available in the same API versions as this object. Otherwise, they’re available in the specified API version and later.

- **RecordsetFltrCritMonitorChangeEvent**: Change events are available for the object.
- **RecordsetFltrCritMonitorHistory**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
